title: Kan fibers and fiber invariance for right fibrations
statement:
Use simplicial sets, horns, quasicategories and equivalences of quasicategories as in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. A simplicial map is a right fibration if every commutative square with left edge $\Lambda_i^n\hookrightarrow\Delta^n$, $n\geq1$ and $0<i\leq n$, admits a diagonal filler. Let $B,E,F$ be small quasicategories in the fixed universe and let $p:E\to B$ and $q:F\to B$ be right fibrations. For every vertex $b$ of $B$, the strict degreewise fibers
$$E_b=\{b\}\times_B E,\qquad F_b=\{b\}\times_B F$$
are Kan complexes. If $h:E\to F$ is an equivalence of quasicategories satisfying $qh=p$, then its induced map $h_b:E_b\to F_b$ is a homotopy equivalence of Kan complexes for every $b$. Here a homotopy equivalence of Kan complexes is a simplicial map admitting a simplicial inverse up to simplicial homotopies, with homotopies modeled by product with $\Delta^1$. Empty fibers are permitted.
